title: Sharplink label
description: The small uppercase label that sits on every section, button and date: 13px, medium, narrow (font-stretch 80%), wide tracking. Full strength or faded.
notes: the narrow cut needs a variable font with a width axis (the Sharplink theme's Archivo); other faces just show their normal width
name: sharplink-label

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render (span by default; p or h3 where it heads something)

props.name: tone
props.description: strong: full text colour; muted: faded to 60%
